question: Choose the correct one-word substitution for:**"A speech or text that praises someone highly ____."**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Eulogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eulogy"** refers to a speech or text that praises someone highly, typically delivered at a funeral to honor the deceased. (स्तुति)
 
 
• **Example:** The priest delivered a heartfelt eulogy to commemorate the life of the departed soul.
 
 
• **"Eulogy"** is the correct word as it specifically refers to a formal expression of praise. (स्तुति)
 
 
• **Example:** She wrote a beautiful eulogy for her grandfather, highlighting his achievements and kindness.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Eulogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Epitaph** (समाधिलेख): A short text written on a tombstone in memory of the deceased.
 
 
• **Example:** The epitaph on his grave read, “Gone but never forgotten.”
 
 
 
• **Sonnet** (चौदह पंक्तियों की कविता): A poem of 14 lines, typically written in iambic pentameter and adhering to a specific rhyme scheme.
 
 
• **Example:** Shakespeare wrote many beautiful sonnets, such as “Sonnet 18,” which begins with “Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?”
 
 
 
• **Lament** (शोक): A passionate expression of grief or sorrow.
 
 
• **Example:** The lament of the widow echoed through the hall as she mourned her loss.
